content.short: Luganodes is an institutional staking and node provider across 40+ proof-of-stake networks.
content.description: Luganodes is a Swiss institutional staking provider running validators on more than 40 proof-of-stake networks with billions of dollars in staked assets, certified to ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Luganodes.
